BUILT 2026-10-12. app/api/cron/this-week/route.ts (GET, force-dynamic) runs Thursdays 15:00 UTC (vercel.json "0 15 * * 4", ~8am PT): cron auth, withCronHeartbeat('this-week'), cronBudget(2000) on the sorted recipient list, the send gate for ('email', 'lifecycle') (the Sunday digest's lever, not the per-RSVP events channel), a cron_run_markers claim under this-week:<profile_id>:<ISO week> BEFORE each send with the same key as the outbox dedupeKey (the SCAN-611 lesson, two walls), a release on a thrown send, and 500 when failed > 0. lib/this-week.ts is the pure half (no Supabase import): the seven-day window cut through eventInstant (starts_at is wall-clock as UTC parts, so the SQL band is widened by 14h each side and the true cut is in code), groupEventsByRegion (only regions with at least one Event come back, so an empty region sends nothing by construction; at most 8 Events per region), the subject exactly `This week in <Region name>`, and the html body plus text twin. lib/this-week-reads.ts holds the three admin reads (nexus_regions; public published live non-demo events with scope_type = 'public' and a scope_region_id; non-demo unsuspended profiles in the bundled regions with an auth user) and the auth.users email read. lib/email.ts sendThisWeekEmail wraps the body in emailShell and enqueues on the bulk lane. THE REGION MATCH is an id equality, events.scope_region_id = profiles.nexus_region_id: the H1-1 typed scope arc (migration 20260829000000) sets scope_region_id to the nexus_region whenever scope_type = 'public', and profiles.nexus_region_id is the onboarding Step 3 pick that get_my_region_id() reads; events.city is host-typed free text and never decides who is told. Registered: lib/observability/slos.ts (weekly freshness group; CRON_UNMONITORED with a reason, the 20-check plan is full), scripts/admin-client-baseline.txt, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md (35 jobs), docs/SLOs.md. Tests: lib/this-week.test.ts and app/api/cron/this-week/route.test.ts.

Closed 2026-10-12: app/api/cron/this-week (Thursday 15:00 UTC) builds This week in <region> from public upcoming Events by scope_region_id and sends to members in that region through the lifecycle send gate, one claim per member per ISO week; empty regions send nothing. Probe passes on the tree.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs"),p=require("path");const r=f=>fs.existsSync(f)?fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8"):"";const walk=(d,o=[])=>{if(!fs.existsSync(d))return o;for(const e of fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})){const q=p.join(d,e.name);if(e.isDirectory()){if(e.name!=="node_modules")walk(q,o)}else if(/\.(tsx?|mjs|md)$/.test(e.name))o.push(q)}return o};const fail=m=>{console.error(m);process.exit(1)};const ID="LIVE-806";const v=JSON.parse(r("vercel.json")||"{}");const crons=(v.crons||[]).filter(c=>/\s4$/.test(String(c.schedule).trim())||/\s(THU|thu)$/.test(String(c.schedule).trim()));const hit=crons.find(c=>{const d="app"+c.path.split("?")[0];return walk(d).concat(walk("lib")).some(f=>/This week in/.test(r(f)))});if(!hit)fail(ID+": no Thursday cron sends a This week in email")'
verify.note: Fails until vercel.json schedules a Thursday cron and the code carries the This week in email.
